text:
Alyssa (Finance): Heads-up: PulseBilling sent renewal + last invoice that includes an unexplained 'integration surcharge'. Renewal list is +17%. Can procurement please validate and look at alternatives?

Omar (Billing): I pulled the invoice: surcharge code PB-INTG-2025 for $9,800. Our export CSV doesn't contain that line. Opening dispute and asked PulseBilling for an itemized justification.

Derek (Procurement): Do not sign renewal until dispute resolved. Also flagging two alternatives for a quick TCO compare: BillRipple and TallyGrid. Need last 8 months usage by sku to compare per-event vs flat pricing.

Nina (Platform): Integration note: PulseBilling currently streams nightly Parquet to S3 and we run reconciles. BillRipple offers incremental webhooks which could reduce batch compute ~12%. TallyGrid has a bulk backfill tool but charges per GB for replays.

Vijay (Security): Before sending any usage, require SOC2 Type II, DPA, and subprocessors list. If vendors want our usage, they need to sign NDA + DPA first. Also ask if they support BYOK.

Alyssa (Finance): Action: Omar, can you export month-by-month totals (events, tokens, bytes) for last 8 months by sku and post sanitized CSV to #finance-data? We want to present committed usage in negotiations.

Omar (Billing): Will upload sanitized CSV in 90m. Sample rows I'll include:

```
month,sku,events,bytes
2024-11,billable_events,132450,287000000
2024-12,billable_events,148900,312400000
```

Omar (Billing): Also requested a credit from PulseBilling for the disputed line; vendor responded they will research and uploaded invoice_note_1781303000.pdf.

Derek (Procurement): I'll draft an RFP template for PulseBilling, BillRipple, and TallyGrid asking for: base, per-event, storage/egress, onboarding/migration credits, backfill pricing, SLA credits, API rate limits, and export schema. Include request for a 30-day pilot discount.

Nina (Platform): Add a question: can vendors provide sample webhook/parquet payload and confirm field names for event_id, timestamp, sku, qty. If BillRipple's webhook maps 1:1 we can POC in ~7 days.

Vijay (Security): Add BYOK, encryption-at-rest, breach notice timelines (within 72h), and right-to-audit to the RFP.

vendor-bot: PulseBilling uploaded renewal_offer_1781303200.pdf and invoice_1781303220.pdf. Renewal summary: list $31,200/mo -> proposed $36,500/mo; integration_surcharge applied.

Derek (Procurement): My negotiable asks: 12mo commit with 15% off list OR 9 months current pricing + 3 months free on a 12mo commit, plus a one-time migration credit if we switch. I'll send RFP under NDA in 48h.

Alyssa (Finance): Perfect. Next steps: Omar uploads CSV (ETA 90m), Derek sends RFP under NDA (ETA 48h), Vijay compiles security checklist. Reconvene when vendor replies. /remind me in 4 days to follow up.
